text:
customer-rep: Hi — customer (AcmeGo) reports their mobile app sees SSE stream cut mid-response when switching from cellular->wifi. They get partial JSON payload and then client retries but gets 401 on resume. Happened 3x today.

maya.k: Thanks — can you paste the exact client logs? App version and auth flow?

customer-rep: app v3.4.1. uses short-lived token (TTL 60s) with background refresh. Logs show: `sse: received 2 events, then ERROR code 1006`, then `auth: token expired` followed by `sse reconnect -> 401`

alex.s: Hmm token TTL 60s is tight. Do we see any server-side accept/reject? @support-bot can you pull stream logs for request id: r-ACME-987?

support-bot: pulled logs for r-ACME-987: initial connect 2026-03-12T10:02:01Z, stream aborted 2026-03-12T10:02:17Z, subsequent connect 2026-03-12T10:02:18Z -> 401 Unauthorized (auth expired)

jordan-eng: Server shows handshake accepted, then we see `auth: token close` at 16s. Looks like client re-negotiates mid-stream; we don't allow token refresh inside a single SSE connection — token TTL must cover duration.

ios-team: On iOS the app attempts silent token refresh on network change; it will reopen SSE with new token. But with short TTL it can race: old connection still open briefly and server invalidates token on refresh.

maya.k: Customer's reproducer steps? Could they run a long prompt and switch networks with dev tools? We need repro.

customer-rep: Repro steps provided: 1) start stream on cellular; 2) after ~15s trigger wifi connect; 3) watch partial payload then 401 on reconnect. They attached HAR and short video. I uploaded to ticket.

jordan-eng: Workaround for now: increase token TTL to >= 120s or delay client token rotation until SSE closed. We can also accept short-lived tokens if client uses reconnection with the same token until SLO? Not ideal.

alex.s: Could we implement graceful token rollover server-side: accept the previous token for a grace window (e.g., 30s) after refresh? Pros/cons?

jordan-eng: Possible. Need security review. For immediate customer relief propose: extend TTL in auth service for this customer and add client guidance: don't refresh mid-SSE; instead refresh and then open new stream after confirming close.

maya.k: I'll send steps and patch notes to CS. @customer-rep can you ask AcmeGo to try TTL=180s and report back? :white_check_mark:

customer-rep: Will do, pinging them now. Thanks team.

support-bot: Note: created internal ticket INF-6043 to track server-side grace-window feature request.
